lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Writing Skills
lessons.description: In this lesson, students will learn the basics of writing skills, including essential grammar and vocabulary. They will be introduced to the passive voice, reported speech, and signpost words.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Advanced Grammar and Vocabulary
lessons.description: Building on the basics, students will delve deeper into advanced grammar and vocabulary, focusing on cohesive devices and paragraph writing. They will also learn about technical vs. general writing.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Understanding Project Reports
lessons.description: This lesson covers the definition, structure, and types of project reports. Students will learn about the purpose and intended audience of project reports, and the importance of avoiding plagiarism.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: STEM Reports and Experimental Writing
lessons.description: Students will explore the specific requirements and writing styles for project reports in STEM fields. They will learn about conducting experiments and performing statistical analysis in their reports.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Final Project Report Writing
lessons.description: In this final lesson, students will apply all the skills learned throughout the course to write a comprehensive project report. They will receive feedback and guidance on their work.
